    Standardness in the independent vocabulary #

    Under translate compatibility, standardness of the corresponding skeleton in the proof library gives standardness of an independent family:

    • the independent k(Γ_A) is equivalent to the all-one scalar mesh category (the two relation ideals agree);
    • a gauge transformation (Lemma 4.4) identifies the all-one scalar mesh category with the one whose coefficients come from almost split sequences;
    • the proof library supplies the equivalence of the latter with ind(mod A).
